subject: Renewal: SOC 2 evidence & retention window request
messages:
From: Janelle Torres <janelle.t@acmepay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmepay.com>, Emily Chen <echen@acmepay.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal & SOC2 evidence: retention window + burst capacity

Rachel —

We’re starting renewal conversations internally and want to align on two items that will determine our path forward: the SOC 2 recert evidence cadence and a change to our log retention window. Specifically:

- We need a 540-day retention window for audit logs (auth logs, API access logs, request/response audit traces) for regulatory reasons tied to a new merchant program.
- We anticipate a short-term capacity spike in November (holiday season) that will require a temporary bump from our current Dedicated pool (4 GPUs) to 6 GPUs for ~6 weeks.

Can Redwood support a 540-day retention option as an amendment to our current SOW? If so, what is the uplift cost and timeline to enable it (we’d like to see it live by 2026-10-01 if possible). Also, for the SOC 2 recert, what artifacts do you need and what is the recommended evidence delivery schedule you prefer?

I’ve attached a draft SOW and a one-pager on the merchant program. Happy to sync this week — Emily and Procurement are on the thread.

Thanks,

— Janelle Torres
Head of Security
Acme Payments

Attachment: Acme_SOW_Draft.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Torres <janelle.t@acmepay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOC2 evidence: retention window + burst capacity

Hi Janelle —

Thanks for the clear ask and the SOW draft. We can support a 540-day retention window and handle the November burst capacity, but there are two pieces to agree on: the operational activation timeline and commercial uplift. High level proposal below — happy to adjust once Procurement weighs in.

Proposed plan:
- Retention uplift: enable 540-day log retention as an optional data-retention amendment. Target live date: 2026-10-01 if we finalize the amendment by 2026-09-24.
- Commercials: one-time configuration fee + monthly retention uplift. Ballpark: $2,500/mo for the retention uplift (we’ll provide a precise breakdown in the amendment).
- Dedicated capacity: short-term bump to 6 GPUs Nov 1 — Dec 15 (6 weeks). We can provide a committed burst rate; interim pricing shown in the attached estimate.
- SOC 2 evidence delivery: recommended 2-week evidence window for the initial handoff (we’ll request exports and supporting docs in that window), then staggered follow-ups for config snapshots and operational runbooks.

Attachments: Evidence_Checklist.xlsx (lists required artifacts: auth logs, API access logs, config snapshots, incident timelines, access reviews, and evidence transfer instructions).

Next steps:
1) If Acme confirms retention uplift and burst capacity (Procurement confirmation), I’ll draft the retention amendment and a short mutual action plan (MAP) with key dates.
2) Kimberly / Logan — can you review the commercial sketch below and confirm discount levers if Acme commits to a 12-month renewal?

Thanks — I’ll book a 30-min call if that makes sense.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachment: Evidence_Checklist.xlsx
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Bcc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Acme - retention uplift + burst pricing (prep for amendment)

Kim / Logan —

Summary of ask from Acme: 540-day log retention; 6 GPU burst Nov 1–Dec 15; target go-live Oct 1. They want pricing and an amendment to the SOW.

Commercials I’m proposing (sketch):
- Retention uplift: $2,500/mo (recurring), one-time config fee $1,000.
- Burst capacity: negotiated at a discounted per-GPU rate for the 6-week window; estimate additional $3,600 total (6 weeks x discounted rate).
- If Acme signs a 12-month renewal, offer 15% discount on the retention uplift (apply from effective date) and waive the one-time config fee.

Operational notes (for Logan):
- Need the retention pipeline enabled by 10/01; engineering lead for retention is assigned but we will need a migration runbook for live logs.
- For SOC 2 evidence: we’ll accept syslog extracts + S3 export for the 2-week evidence handoff. Confirm acceptable formats and any transfer bandwidth constraints.

Marissa — tagging you for compliance wording: is there any policy restriction about extending retention to 540 days for a customer in our standard offering? If we need an exception, we should document it in the amendment.

Can you both confirm these numbers ASAP so I can draft the amendment and MAP for Acme? I’ll aim to have a first draft by EOD 9/15.

Thanks,
Rachel
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Torres <janelle.t@acmepay.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmepay.com>, Emily Chen <echen@acmepay.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Retention amendment & November burst — agreement and next steps

Hi Janelle / Emily / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Per our internal review, Redwood can support the 540-day retention window and the November burst. Below are the confirmed terms we’ll include in the retention amendment and SOW update: 

Confirmed commercial terms:
- Retention uplift: $2,500/month (recurring) for 540-day retention.
- One-time configuration fee: waived with a signed 12-month renewal agreement.
- November burst: temporary increase to 6 GPUs from Nov 1 — Dec 15, 2026. Estimated incremental charge for burst (post-discount): $3,600.
- Discount: 15% applied to the monthly retention uplift if Acme signs a 12-month renewal by 2026-09-24.

Operational timeline and MAP:
- 2026-09-20: kickoff call to review Evidence_Checklist and transfer mechanics.
- 2026-09-24: target for signed amendment to lock the 10/01 go-live date.
- 2026-10-01: retention uplift live (assuming signed amendment).
- 2026-11-01 to 2026-12-15: burst capacity window.

Evidence handoff:
- Initial 2-week evidence window (requested exports: auth logs, API access logs, config snapshots). We will accept syslog exports or S3 transfer. Rachel will circulate the final evidence handoff checklist on kickoff.

Action items for Acme:
1) Confirm acceptance of the commercial terms and the MAP.
2) Sign the DocuSign retention amendment by 2026-09-24 if you want the Oct 1 go-live and the 15% renewal discount. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/ABC1234
3) Prepare sample exports (1 week before kickoff) to validate transfer format.

I’ve attached the draft retention amendment (Retention_Amendment_1.0.docx) and the SOW with the November burst pricing. If you’re good with these terms I’ll route the DocuSign for signature today.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

Attachment: Retention_Amendment_1.0.docx
